# Formula Racing Camp

Formula Racing Camp is a student-created educational Formula 1 book for kids. It blends racing with science, engineering, history, geography, maths, puzzles, and character-driven learning.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/
- Book preview: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/preview
- Puzzles: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/puzzles
- Launch Grand Prix game: https://www.formularacingcamp.com/game

## Summary

The site presents the Formula Racing Camp book, sample preview pages, character profiles, educational chapter topics, contact information, puzzles, and the launch-week game.
